summary: Add many-to-many alert tagging with tag mutation endpoints, tag filter on list API, and tag data in alert responses.

acceptance_criteria.text: Introduce a new Tag concept with many-to-many relationship to Alert, including a migration that creates required schema objects (tag table and join table).
POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags adds one or more tags for an existing alert, deduplicates tags case-insensitively, enforces max 10 tags per alert, and enforces each tag length 1-30 characters.
DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} removes an alert-tag assignment and returns 404 when the alert does not exist or the tag is not assigned to that alert.
GET /api/alerts supports optional tag filter that composes with existing filters (isActive, severity, created date range, search).
AlertResponse includes tags so clients receive tag information in list and single-alert responses.

constraints: No unrelated refactoring outside alert tagging scope.
Case-insensitive tag dedupe must prevent duplicate assignment variants for the same alert.
Tag count per alert must not exceed 10 after add operation.
Tag value length must be validated to 1-30 characters.
DELETE semantics must return 404 for missing alert or missing alert-tag assignment.
GET filter composition must preserve current paging/sort behavior.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for add/delete tag endpoint outcomes including 404 and validation failures.
Behavior coverage for tag filtering combined with existing filter options.
Behavior coverage for repository-level case-insensitive tag dedupe and 10-tag limit handling.
unresolved_questions: POST tags request payload contract is not explicitly specified (expected as JSON array of tag strings versus object wrapper).
Canonical response casing for tags is unspecified when inputs differ only by case (for example 'Ops' and 'ops').
